purpose: Freeze candidate theoretical/publication claims and their falsifiers before headline evaluation or peer-review feedback.

claims.claim: RAKL is a distinct scientific-method layer for LLM-mediated inquiry when defined by the conjunction of projection/context-first representation, typed non-forced gluing, scoped authority, evidence-gated proposal updates, residual-driven recursion, semantic-lineage saturation, and governed self-application.
not_claimed: novelty of active learning or Bayesian experiment design
novelty of provenance or knowledge graphs
novelty of perspectivalism or sheaf theory
novelty of partial identification or belief revision
claims.falsifier: A pre-cutoff prior method is found that is semantically equivalent to the integrated RAKL control law after terminology normalization.

claims.claim: LLM/proposer output alone cannot increase canonical scientific authority under the RAKL state transition.
claims.falsifier: An admissible RAKL transition exists in which proposer text raises canonical authority without new evidence or an explicitly licensed authority rule.

claims.claim: Weaker, mixed, or differently scoped relation edges do not imply stronger equivalence without a licensed composition map.
claims.falsifier: A valid RAKL closure rule promotes mixed/weak relation paths to stronger authority without additional evidence/assumptions.

claims.claim: Aligned incompatible views may remain a plural atlas, obstruction, or identified set rather than being forced into one global theory.
claims.falsifier: RAKL's normative transition rules require arbitrary global selection despite unresolved incompatibility or non-identifiability.

claims.claim: Null and refuted evidence remains addressable after later method/state updates.
claims.falsifier: A valid successor state can erase a prior negative event or make it untraceable without explicit supersession provenance.

claims.claim: RAKL stopping uses retained semantic novelty plus route coverage and process/evidence-lineage independence rather than document or agent count.
claims.falsifier: The proposed saturation rule certifies a fiber when required routes are unsearched, lineage overlap is unresolved, or a material native residual within scope remains open.

claims.claim: The RAKL controls reduce predicted epistemic failure modes relative to matched agentic baselines or their corresponding ablations.
claims.falsifier: Under matched model/tool/budget/evaluator conditions, the defining controls do not improve their registered failure-mode metrics or only improve surface report quality.

claims.claim: Self-RAKL can improve method modules without granting candidates authority over the evidence that judges the same improvement.
claims.falsifier: A candidate-controlled evaluator or benchmark mutation can independently authorize candidate promotion under the active protocol.

required_independent_reviews: adversarial reviewer asked specifically to find an equivalent prior framework
benchmark reviewer checking whether empirical tests actually identify RAKL-specific mechanisms
claim_update_rule: New evidence may narrow, refute, or supersede a claim with history preserved. It may not silently broaden the claim or weaken its falsifier after results are observed.
